newsitem.title: UK: LME metals lose ground, copper sliding.
newsitem.headline: LME metals lose ground, copper sliding.

text.p: COPPER - Extends decline after pre-market failure at $2.600. Trend accentuated by cash offers and easing in spread rates.
ALUMINIUM - In minus column after commission house sales.
LEAD - Easier, testing $615 - recent lowest since October 1995.
ZINC - Lower, matches others. NICKEL - Easier, stops hit under $7,200. TIN - Easier after Far East sales, above recent low. ALLOY - Slow.
